quarterly_data.signal: CoreWeave and Parallel Works announced the deployment of a managed AI and high-performance computing platform for the DARPA Network of Optimal Dynamic Energy Signatures (NODES) program: Parallel Works operates the environment through its ACTIVATE control plane on CoreWeave's AI cloud, using a dedicated reservation on NVIDIA HGX H100 systems with NVIDIA Quantum InfiniBand networking, accessed through SUNK and CoreWeave Kubernetes Service. No contract value or size is stated.
quarterly_data.figure: dedicated NVIDIA HGX H100 reservation; no value stated
